name: flux-bio
description: Open-source Link in bio with short links and click tracking, running entirely on Cloudflare Workers.

scripts.typecheck: cf workers types && tsc -p tsconfig.worker.json && tsc -p tsconfig.app.json && tsc -p tsconfig.node.json
scripts.landing:deploy: node scripts/landing-owner.mjs && node scripts/landing-pictures.mjs && node landing/build.mjs && cd landing && cf deploy --prebuilt

ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: 後台登入密碼，至少 12 個字元。The password for the admin dashboard, at least 12 characters.

DB.description: D1 資料庫：頁面內容、短網址與點擊統計。D1 database for your page, short links and click stats.

KV.description: KV：已發布的頁面、短網址快取與上傳的圖片。KV for the published page, the short link cache and uploaded images.
